_doc: I: action -> motion file (relative to the experiment root). Default = M's canonical motion/<act>.json (M: the variants in motion/variants/ are the owner's pick list; swap a path here when a variant becomes the default). loop null = take the motion file's 'loop'. Actions with a missing motion file are skipped (dash/hurt appear when M posts them). dirs 'auto' = every view in rig/align.json; override with env DIRS='SE E S'.
